cluster_summary: Multiple vulnerabilities in a browser sandboxing system arise from the assumption that network isolation (e.g., loopback) is sufficient for security, leading to missing authentication on critical endpoints, improper token scoping, misconfigured network bindings, and stale authorization caches. These issues allow local or network attackers to gain unauthorized access to browser debugging, VNC, code-server, and profile management functions.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-controlled webhook URLs, callback URLs, endpoint parameters, or request destinations into outbound HTTP clients, URL.openConnection, fetch helpers, proxy clients, or webhook dispatchers. Report code paths where scheme, host, redirect target, DNS resolution, and private-address ranges are not constrained before the outbound request. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should enforce scheme and host allowlists, block private and metadata addresses after DNS resolution, and validate redirect targets.

mechanism.missing_guard: scheme, host, redirect target, DNS resolution, and private-address ranges are not constrained before the outbound request
mechanism.name: attacker-controlled webhook or callback URL fetch
mechanism.sink_shape: outbound HTTP clients, URL.openConnection, fetch helpers, proxy clients, or webhook dispatchers
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-controlled webhook URLs, callback URLs, endpoint parameters, or request destinations
mechanism.typical_fix: enforce scheme and host allowlists, block private and metadata addresses after DNS resolution, and validate redirect targets

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Add validation calls (e.g., assertCdpEndpointAllowed) for WebSocket URLs; separate SSRF policies for CDP health checks and browser navigation.
sub_patterns.name: SSRF due to missing or incorrect URL validation/policy
sub_patterns.root_cause: WebSocket URLs from user input or service responses are not validated against an SSRF policy, or user-configured CDP hostnames are incorrectly merged into the browser navigation allowlist.
